Line 3854 `if not location_constraint: pytest.skip(...)` skips empty `api_name` (making lines 3862-3863 `if location_constraint == "": location_constraint = None` dead unreachable code), while Spec §13.A mandates `region = us-east-1`, for which AWS S3 GetBucketLocation returns empty `<LocationConstraint/>` (`None` in botocore), making line 3864 `None == non_empty_api_name` unsatisfiable for every `api_name`.
